title: The Airport That Knocked Atlanta Off The Map
hook: For one year, it wasn't Atlanta.
source: Airports Council International (ACI World) annual passenger rankings; Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta figures from airport/ACI reporting; Guangzhou Baiyun figures from ACI World rankings and Chinese aviation authority reports. 2022-2023 Guangzhou figures approximate (exact totals not fully published; derived from ACI global-rank position). Figures approximate.
